description: This file declares interfaces, macros, and includes relevant headers for the Windows SSPI (Security Support Provider Interface) implementation of the SSL/TLS layer within the cURL project, specifically for the Schannel backend. It includes external Windows headers and defines external variables and function prototypes related to certificate and host verification.

methods.name: Curl_verify_host
methods.description: Function to verify the hostname against the server certificate.

methods.name: Curl_verify_certificate
methods.description: Function to verify the server's SSL certificate.
